ody.text: Cabal City was the pit-fighting city where Kamahl arrived, lured by a mysterious call, and befriended Chainer and Seton, while Chainer found the Mirari in a ruined manor's basement but decided it was fit only for the First of the Cabal.

Turg ate a Krosan dragonette, and its call drew a full-grown dragon to devastate the city; Kamahl killed it, but Kirtar was credited and took the Mirari as his prize, starting the Battle for the Mirari.
Kamahl and Chainer later formed a record-winning pit partnership that broke when Kamahl refused the First's order to throw a match, and the Order attacked the city.

Chainer usurped the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch, dementia creatures overran the city, and when he lost control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl, the city was condemned and abandoned.

tor.text: In Torment, the Patriarch arranged Skellum's death in a pit fight, and Chainer swore revenge, slaughtering Teroh's corps and many healers to earn the use of the Mirari.
Chainer used the Mirari to power a Death Bloom that killed the Patriarch's guards, forcing the Patriarch into exile in Aphetto, and took control of Cabal City.
At the Mirari games an Order justiciar and angels attacked, and an infuriated Chainer tapped the dementia space of almost every caster on Otaria, unleashing carnage in the city.
Kamahl confronted Chainer, whose healing went wrong as the Mirari overwhelmed him, and Chainer begged to be killed; Kamahl tearfully did so and took the Mirari as promised.
